cards.text: Three of them, waiting by your exit, in no particular hurry. The one in front has the patient look of somebody doing an errand.
As you get closer your recognise him - Nick, the one who sucker-punched Archie during that first sale. Feels like a lifetime ago.

cards.speaker: Firm Man
cards.text: "Newbie... you've been busy." Nick has a smile that doesn't reach his eyes. "Fate, physics - bit ambitious for someone who was doing a doing a bad impression of a scarecrow behind a chicken shop just the other week."

cards.speaker: Firm Man
cards.text: "Nobody's asking you to stop. Just letting you know it's been noticed."
He hasn't threatened you. He's been very careful not to.

choices.label: Back off
choices.result_text: You take the long way round. Nothing happens, which is the point -  somebody wanted you to know they've got an eye on you, and now you know.

choices.label: Hold your ground
choices.result_text: You don't move and you don't say anything. He waits, decides it isn't worth the afternoon, and they go. He is slightly less pleasant on the way past.

choices.label: Tell them where to go
choices.result_text: You tell him. There is a moment where it could still go either way, and then it doesn't.

cards.text: The patches are still yours to give away. It might be best to tell Des quickly, before this site is snatched up by someone else.
